description.value: O'Hare's is a combined gastropub and liquor store serving the Steveston neighbourhood of Richmond, BC. The gastropub side offers a full food menu with dine-in service, while the attached retail store covers alcohol purchases to go. Its location on Steveston Highway places it within easy reach of the South Richmond dyke cycling network and the historic Steveston waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 6m; rack at 13m.
